name: 92277 · Twentynin Plm, CA
findings: ZIP 92277 (Twentynin Plm) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92277 (Twentynin Plm) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
